cases.title: 第四款游戏的制作展示

tweet.text:
You guys still don’t understand HOW insane Opus 5.5 actually is

literally one dude (me) built this entire 3D world: 

- with no coding background; 
- coming home after a regular 9-to-5 job;
- using 93% of a basic $20 weekly sub quota
- in just 12 hours total

READ that again…

- all game mechanics, water, grass, terrain, sky, dynamic weather + day/night cycle: built by opus 5.5
- car and campfire: written 100% in code by sonnet 5.5
- AK-47, boat, bed, knife, hands: generated on meshy free tier

all debugging, testing, and logic integration: pure opus 5.5
and it runs in JUST three.js natively in the browser
period.
